<style>
.ap-idx{--surface:#fcfcfb;--ink:#0b0b0b;--ink2:#52514e;--muted:#6b6a66;--rule:#e4e2dc;--grid:#ecebe7;
--main:#2a78d6;--ctx:#8a8984;--bar:#2a78d6;--card:#f4f3ef;color-scheme:light}
.ap-idx *{box-sizing:border-box}
.ap-idx{color:var(--ink);}
.ap-idx .ficha{border-top:3px solid var(--ink);padding-top:16px;margin-bottom:72px}
.ap-idx .eyebrow{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.ap-idx h2{font-size:26px;margin:4px 0 12px}
.ap-idx h2 .code{font-size:14px;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted)}
.ap-idx h3{font-size:16px;margin:28px 0 4px}
.ap-idx .ident{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:8px 24px;margin:0}
.ap-idx .ident dt{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.ap-idx .ident dd{margin:0}
.ap-idx .verdict{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:12px;margin:20px 0 8px}
.ap-idx .kpi{background:var(--card);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.ap-idx .kpi-label{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.ap-idx .kpi-value{font-size:30px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.1}
.ap-idx .kpi-value.small{font-size:20px}
.ap-idx .kpi-note{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2)}
.ap-idx .catbadge{align-self:flex-start;font-weight:600;font-size:17px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:6px;border-left:6px solid var(--c);background:var(--surface)}
.ap-idx .flags{margin:8px 0;padding-left:18px;color:var(--ink2);font-size:14px}
.ap-idx .muted{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin:2px 0 8px}
.ap-idx table.num{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:14px;margin:8px 0}
.ap-idx table.num th,.ap-idx table.num td{padding:4px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);text-align:right}
.ap-idx table.num th:first-child,.ap-idx table.num td:first-child{text-align:left}
.ap-idx table.num thead th{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink2);font-size:12px}
.ap-idx tr.sub th,.ap-idx tr.sub td{font-weight:600;background:var(--card)}
.ap-idx td.ind{padding-left:20px!important}
.ap-idx .chart{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.ap-idx .chart .grid{stroke:var(--grid);stroke-width:1}
.ap-idx .chart .split{stroke:var(--muted);stroke-dasharray:3 3}
.ap-idx .chart .tick{fill:var(--muted);font-size:11px}
.ap-idx .chart .val{fill:var(--ink2);font-size:12px}
.ap-idx .chart .line{fill:none;stroke-width:2;stroke-linejoin:round}
.ap-idx .chart .line.main{stroke:var(--main)}
.ap-idx .chart .line.ctx{stroke:var(--ctx);stroke-dasharray:6 4}
.ap-idx .chart .line.nat{stroke:var(--main);stroke-width:1.5;stroke-dasharray:1.5 3;opacity:.8}
.ap-idx .chart .dlabel{font-size:12px;fill:var(--ink2)}
.ap-idx .chart .hit{fill:transparent}
.ap-idx .chart .hit:hover{fill:var(--main);fill-opacity:.25}
.ap-idx .chart .bar{fill:var(--bar)}
.ap-idx .two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:24px}
.ap-idx details{margin:8px 0;font-size:13px}
.ap-idx .targets{color:var(--ink2);padding-left:18px}
.ap-idx footer{border-top:1px solid var(--rule);margin-top:28px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.ap-idx .mapwrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 260px;gap:16px;align-items:start}
@media (max-width:700px){.ap-idx .mapwrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.ap-idx .mapbox{position:relative;display:table;margin:0 auto}
.ap-idx .map{display:block;max-width:100%;max-height:560px;width:auto;height:auto;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:6px;background:#fff}
.ap-idx .scalebar{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:10px;right:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;pointer-events:none}
.ap-idx .scalebar .bar{margin-left:10px;height:6px;border:1.5px solid #222;border-top:none;background:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
.ap-idx .scalebar .lab{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#222;background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);padding:0 4px;border-radius:3px}
.ap-idx .map.placeholder{padding:48px 16px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;background:var(--card)}
.ap-idx .legend{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;font-size:13px}
.ap-idx .legend li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:14px 1fr;column-gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px}
.ap-idx .legend .sw{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;margin-top:3px;grid-row:span 2}
.ap-idx .legend .lv{color:var(--muted);grid-column:2}
.ap-idx table.idx td,.ap-idx table.idx th{text-align:left!important}
.ap-idx table.idx td:nth-child(6),.ap-idx table.idx td:nth-child(8){text-align:right!important}
.ap-idx nav.topnav{font-size:13px;margin-bottom:10px}
.ap-idx nav.topnav a{color:var(--main);margin-right:16px}
.ap-idx nav.toc{font-size:14px;margin-bottom:24px}
.ap-idx nav.toc a{color:var(--main);margin-right:16px}
</style>
